svg.title: Red Breach movement gym extension: proposed top-down plan
svg.desc: A west-side annex with four jump lanes, a 20 meter sprint runway, and three crouch clearance tunnels, connected to the existing gym by a three meter opening.
svg.text: Top-down spatial plan • Godot metres • 1 m grid • north = −Z
4 m DEEP STAGING / RESET TO YOUR LANE
Miss → reset at that lane’s approach
Show walk / sprint time and best run
Stand after clearing the low opening
Same 0.60 m width; feet stay on the floor.
Hold Ctrl: slower movement and lower viewpoint.
Jump from crouch only after safe standing clearance.
8 m run-up; at least 4 m of landing depth.
Gaps are measured edge to edge.
Misses reset locally; no damage or long walk back.
Passing distances come from the playtest.
Reliable walking and sprinting jump distances.
Travel time for planning corridors and encounters.
Crouched height, speed, and cover sightlines.
Safe standing beneath and beyond low ceilings.
Stairs, ramps, and doors still work in both stances.
Sprint stays unlimited. Timing is a measurement tool.
Next module: first weapon + ammo, then an enemy.
PLAN FIRST → REVIEW THE SPACE → BUILD IN TRENCHBROOM → PLAYTEST
